cohort: Dichorionic diamniotic twins delivering at ≥32 weeks' gestation
finding: Neonatal outcomes were worse for twins delivered via emergency cesarean section or instrumental vaginal delivery compared with elective cesarean section or uncomplicated vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Neonatal outcomes were worse for twins delivered via emergency cesarean section or instrumental vaginal delivery compared with elective cesarean section or uncomplicated vaginal delivery.
